text: Mechanized infantry flanking operations require prior reconnaissance and validated routes
Force concentration exceeding 3 maneuver battalions in a single axis requires commander approval
Artillery support requests must include target verification and collateral damage assessment
Withdrawal operations must be coordinated with adjacent units and approved by commander
River crossing operations require engineer support and are classified as deliberate attacks
Reserve forces may not be committed without commander authorization
Engagement in civilian populated areas requires escalation and legal review
